newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Croat Catholic nun stabbed to death in Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: Croat Catholic nun stabbed to death in Bosnia.

text.p: A Croat Roman Catholic nun was stabbed to death in the Moslem-dominated central Bosnian town of Kakanj, United Nations police monitors said on Tuesday.
A spokesman for the International Police Task Force in postwar Bosnia Andrea Angeli said the the 46-year-old nun was stabbed six times on Monday night in Kakanj.
He said the nun belonged to the Order of the Daughters of God's Love and was a native of Vitez, in a Croat-controlled poxket of central Bosnia some 20 km (12 miles) west of Kakanj.
